answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested payouts released over many epochs, like a gale testing each tree while a lotus blooms only after long seasons underwater and rewards wait until the summit of a long climb. New agent identities earn into a vesting schedule spanning dozens of epochs; slashing for fraud or exit forfeits unvested balance. A flash-farm attacker spinning thousands of fake agents collects only a fraction before being cut off, since each identity must stay honest and active long enough to vest, making bulk sybils unprofitable.
